message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta’s local authorities. Here’s how to do it: | Step | What to Do | Where / How | |------|------------|-------------| | **1** | Identify the type of noise issue (e.g., late‑night construction, loud music, barking dogs, etc.). | Gather details: time, location, description, and any evidence (photos, videos, audio recordings). | | **2** | File the complaint online. | • Visit the City of Atlanta’s 311 portal:
• Search “Noise Complaint” or “Noise Ordinance.”
• Fill out the form with your contact info, incident details, and attach any evidence. | | **3** | Call the City’s 311 hotline. | • Phone: **404‑656‑4000** (or 311 from within Atlanta).
• Provide the same information you would submit online. | | **4** | Email the complaint. | • Email: **noise@atlantaga.gov**
• Include all details and attachments. | | **5** | Visit the City Hall in person (optional). | • Address: 55 Marietta Street NW, Atlanta, GA 30303
• You can speak directly with a public safety officer or the Noise Control Division. | ### Who Handles Noise Complaints in Atlanta? - **City of Atlanta Police Department** – Handles enforcement of the city’s noise ordinance. - **Department of Public Safety** – Coordinates with the police for noise enforcement and community outreach. - **Atlanta Neighborhood Watch** – Can assist in reporting repeated or persistent noise issues. ### Key Points About Atlanta’s Noise Ordinance - **Hours of Enforcement:** Generally, noise is regulated between 10 p.m. and 7 a.m. on weekdays, and 11 p.m. to 7 a.m. on weekends. - **Allowed Decibel Levels:** The ordinance sets specific decibel limits for residential and commercial areas. - **Penalties:** Violations can result in fines, citations, or other enforcement actions. ### Tips for a Successful Complaint 1. **Be Specific:** Provide exact times, dates, and descriptions. 2. **Provide Evidence:** Attach photos, videos, or audio recordings if possible. 3. **Follow Up:** If you don’t receive a response within a few days, call 311 or email again. 4. **Document Everything:** Keep copies of your complaint submission and any correspondence. ### Quick Links - **Noise Ordinance PDF:** - **311 Online Portal:** - **City of Atlanta Police Department:** By following these steps, you can effectively report a noise complaint to the City of Atlanta and help maintain a peaceful community environment.
